primitives.note: Rocket Grab hits on cast/short delay for magic damage; Static Field active detonation deals magic damage on cast
Power Fist's empowered auto resets Blitzcrank's basic attack timer
Power Fist arms the next basic attack with bonus physical damage and treats it as spell damage for item procs
Overdrive grants bonus attack speed for 5s, directly raising DPS
Static Field passive applies a stack per basic attack while off cooldown; one stack detonates per second dealing magic damage
The per-second stack detonation behaves like a ticking damage effect on the target while stacks persist
All 4 abilities cost mana (100/75/25/100); mana is finite over the 15s fight and constrains cast frequency, especially with W+Q+R being expensive
Power Fist's cooldown starts post-effect (after the empowered attack resolves), effectively lengthening real time between casts vs on-cast starts

Mana Barrier is a self-shield triggered at low health; irrelevant to the damage fight where Blitzcrank is the attacker vs a non-retaliating dummy, but relevant to the survival fight where it delays Blitzcrank's death

needsBespoke.why: All damage-relevant mechanics (Q burst, W attack-speed buff, E empowered-attack-with-reset, R stacking on-hit ticks plus a plain-cast burst) map onto existing primitives; no unique interaction requires bespoke logic.

proposal: Open by casting Rocket Grab (Q) on the dummy for immediate magic burst damage and the guaranteed follow-up auto-attack.
Immediately cast Overdrive (W) to gain bonus attack speed for the fight's core damage window.
Weave in Power Fist (E) on cooldown, always letting it land as the very next auto-attack for its doubled/bonus physical damage and to trigger an attack-reset.
Auto-attack continuously between E casts to build Static Field (R) stacks and to benefit from Overdrive's attack speed.
Cast Static Field (R) active once available (post-cooldown/rank) for its magic burst, ideally when mana allows without starving Q/E casts.
Recast Rocket Grab (Q) again on cooldown for another magic burst.
Recast Overdrive (W) when it comes off cooldown to maintain the attack-speed window for the remainder of the fight.
Continue weaving Power Fist on cooldown and auto-attacking to keep Static Field stacks ticking until the 15s window ends.
questions: Given four abilities all costing mana (Q100/W75/E25/R100) at early levels, what mana pool and regen should be assumed so the simulator knows how many full rotations are actually sustainable in 15s?
Should the simulator model the Q's forced follow-up auto-attack as attack-reset-relevant (i.e., does it interact with Power Fist's own reset or Static Field stacking) or treat it as a normal attack?

At what point does R's cooldown (60/40/20s by rank) make it unavailable during a single 15s fight at low ranks — should the rotation assume max rank R for a fair damage comparison, or model rank-appropriate availability?
Is Power Fist's cdstart = post-effect meaningful within 15s (i.e., does the attack windup + reset meaningfully delay E's next availability compared to treating it as on-cast)?
